Chapter 912: Chapter 13: The Seventh Realm of Space-Time (Please Subscribe)_2

In an instant, within the palm-sized universe, space-time collapsed, endless demonic creatures turned into dust before the boiling space-time, and the six Emperor of Demonic Beings persisted for a few moments before also becoming nothing but ashes.

All the demonic creatures were shattered by the Power of Space-Time, then transformed into the most primordial Demonic Qi by the Primal Force.

This most primordial Demonic Qi, which belongs to the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss, was suppressed by Lin Yuan as part of his research on the Ancestor of the Demon Abyss lying dormant in the depths of the Demon Abyss.

“Hmm?”

Just after the foremost Emperor of Demonic Beings among the six utterly perished, billions of miles away from Cangwu Immortal City, the remaining Demonic Qi converged, once again forming a silhouette.

However, compared to the majestic stature of a normal Emperor of Demonic Beings, this silhouette had shrunk significantly, and its aura was weak, having fallen to the level of an ordinary Jade Immortal.

“I survived?”

The Emperor of Demonic Beings was ecstatic. Most Emperors of Demonic Beings were invincible in their own right, with no need to prepare any means of survival.

However, this Emperor of Demonic Beings was naturally cautious, and even when attacking the nearly invincible Cangwu Immortal City, it had left a will hidden elsewhere in advance.

Sure enough, this now came into great use. With the physical body perished, the will resurrected, it was like having ‘come back to life’.

“Demon Abyss…”

Without hesitation, the Emperor of Demonic Beings called upon the Demon Abyss, seeking to escape into its depths.

From beginning to end, it never knew why its true self died, nor who had killed it.

But that did not stop the fear of the Emperor of Demonic Beings; if it did not escape now, there would be truly no chance to flee.

Buzz, buzz, buzz!

The vast phantom of the Demon Abyss descended.

Like a colossal mouth that sought to swallow the Emperor of Demonic Beings in one gulp.

But the next moment,

A gigantic hand composed entirely of space-time stretched out.

It forcibly snatched the Emperor of the Demon Abyss right from under that colossal maw.

The Demon Abyss Power lingered for a while, but eventually dissipated swiftly.

…

“Still trying to run?”

Lin Yuan looked at the ant-like creature within his palm and casually crushed it, suppressing the Primordial Demonic Qi once more.

“No response from the Ancestor of the Immortal Path yet?”

Since taking action, most of Lin Yuan’s attention had not been on the demonic beings but rather upon the Origin of the Immortal Realm, watching for any movements from the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

With a palm, Lin Yuan had captured the heavens full of demonic beings, showing a strength close to that of the twelfth grade, which might alert the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

In fact, this was also Lin Yuan’s test for the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, wanting to understand exactly what state the other party was in.

“Forget it.”

After waiting a moment and seeing that the Origin of the Immortal Realm still showed no reaction, Lin Yuan simply turned and entered the cultivation area, planning to take that final step and step into the Seventh Realm of Space-Time.

…

Lin Yuan effortlessly resolved all the demonic beings, and even before the face of the Demon Abyss, he captured an Emperor of the Demon Abyss, then turned around to continue his seclusion.

It seemed like a long time had passed, but in reality, it was only a few breaths’ worth of time.

In Cangwu Immortal City, countless immortals were fleeing in panic, desperate one moment, and in the next, they found that the endless swarm of demonic beings that had shaken the entire Immortal City to the brink had vanished?

It wasn’t the disappearance of one or a few, but all had vanished.

If not for the collapsed structures and ground within the city, many immortals would probably think what they just experienced was an illusion.

“Where are the demonic beings?”

“What happened?”

“Not sure, where are those demonic beings?”

“Could it be that they retreated?”

…

Countless immortals were somewhat dumbfounded as they exchanged information rapidly, but overall, there was a collective sigh of relief.

…

Compared to the many confused immortals, the numerous high-ranking leaders of Cangwu Immortal City were shocked.

“The demonic beings retreated?”

“Absolutely impossible for them to retreat.”

“That’s right, sixty percent of the defensive formations of Cangwu Immortal City have collapsed. If they continued a bit longer, those six Emperors of Demonic Beings could have breached the city. Retreat at this moment?”

“Correct.”

…

The high-ranking officials of the Immortal City are far more informed than the other immortals, and they are well aware of the extent to which the defense formation of Cangwu Immortal City is on the brink of collapse.

As much as they are reluctant to accept it, the many Jade Immortalls can ascertain that the fate of Cangwu Immortal City will be consumption by endless demonic beings.

These top-tier Jade Immortals will also be devoured by those Emperor of Demonic Beings.

But at the last moment, all the demonic beings disappeared?

The high-ranking officials of the Immortal City are not fools; they are well aware of the nature of these demonic beings and that they would not give up prey that is within their grasp.

“They haven’t retreated; could it be that they were dealt with?”

“Dealt with? Did Ancestral Master make his move?”

The Immortal City Lord’s mind stirred; the six Emperor of Demonic Beings could tear open the Immortal City’s defense formation when working in unison. Apart from the exalted Ancestral Master, he could not conceive of any other being capable of resolving the situation so effortlessly.

“My ancestor he…” Among the many top-tier Jade Immortals, a young-looking Jade Immortal hesitated slightly, then shook his head and spoke.

As a disciple of the Ancestral Master, he knew that the Ancestral Master would definitely not take action during this time, otherwise, he would not have allowed three Immortal Cities to be breached.

“It wasn’t the Ancestral Master who acted?”

The city lord of the Immortal City and other high-ranking figures fell into silence, mostly convinced.

After all, if Ancestral Master had made a move, the divine presence of the Immortal Realm would enshroud the entire Immortal Realm; all demonic beings would retreat, and even the Demon Abyss would keep its distance. But now, besides Cangwu Immortal City, the other domains in the Immortal Realm are still ravaged by demonic beings.

This does not align with the scenario where Ancestral Master would intervene.

However.

If it wasn’t Ancestral Master who acted.

Then, who would have intervened?

Apart from Ancestral Master, who else in the Immortal Realm could possibly have the means to resolve six Emperor of Demonic Beings in an instant?

The city lord of Immortal City and other high-level officials could not understand.

“Have you noticed something amiss with the Cave Mansion Area of our Immortal City…”

While the many high-ranking officials of the Immortal City were in deep contemplation, a vice city lord began to check the overall situation of the Immortal City and immediately discovered the anomaly.

Under the siege of infinite demonic beings and the six Emperor of Demonic Beings, the defense formation of Cangwu Immortal City had collapsed a great deal, and its internal formations were likewise damaged extensively.

Now, the entirety of Cangwu Immortal City looks like a sieve full of holes, where one can see from one end to the other.

The numerous lofty officials, who had partial control over the Immortal City’s formation, were able to observe the entire Immortal City without any impediment, from beginning to end.

After all, Cangwu Immortal City is now akin to half a ruin, with most formations collapsed, making it difficult to conceal any secrets.

Under such circumstances.

The Cave Mansion Area of the Immortal City, one particular Grade-A cave mansion, remained intact, in stark contrast with other Grade-A mansions around it.

If it were just like that, it would be let go. Maybe it was just the luck of this specific mansion that prevented it from being affected by the repercussions.

But now this deputy city lord, using the remaining authority of the Immortal City’s formation, was still unable to peek into that Grade-A cave mansion; he immediately sensed that something was amiss.

Moreover, during the demonic siege on the city, all immortals from the mansion area had mostly fled their domiciles; apart from this Grade-A mansion, the rest were all empty.

Such anomalies naturally caught the attention of the many high-ranking officials of the Immortal City.

“This mansion…”

The city lord of the Immortal City’s expression shifted slightly.

As a top-tier Jade Immortal, he also noted that in contrast to the panicked owners of other mansions, this Grade-A mansion seemed incredibly composed, showing no sign of fleeing.

It was as if they had already known that the demonic beings outside would be taken care of.

This made the officials of the Immortal City cannot help but speculate: might the owner of this Grade-A mansion have some connection with the being who resolved the demonic beings outside the Immortal City?

“Is it Master Yun Zhenzi’s mansion?” the Hall Master of Flying Immortal Hall was also somewhat incredulous.

“You know the owner of this mansion?” The city lord of the Immortal City’s gaze immediately shifted over, and other high-ranking officials also turned their attention.

The information on the owners of Grade-A mansions within the Immortal City was accessible to many of the Jade Immortals present.

But knowing the identity of the mansion’s owner does not mean they are acquainted.

…

Within the mansion.

At this moment, Lin Yuan sat cross-legged with bursts of enlightenment flashing in his mind.

Without the disturbances from those demonic beings outside, Lin Yuan continued to rapidly advance in his comprehension of space-time, approaching the final leap.

“Space-time, space-time, so this is space-time!”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, a smile appearing on his face.
